verses.english: Linked Discourses 4.23
3. Māra
With Godhika
So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā godhiko isigilipasse viharati kāḷasilāyaṁ.
verses.english: Now at that time Venerable Godhika was staying on the slopes of Isigili at the Black Rock.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmayikaṁ cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: Then Venerable Godhika, meditating diligent, keen, and resolute, experienced temporary freedom of heart.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
verses.english: But then he fell away from that temporary freedom of heart.

verses.pali: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmayikaṁ cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: For a second …

verses.pali: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
Tatiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmayikaṁ cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: third …

verses.pali: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā …pe… parihāyi.
Catutthampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto …pe… vimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: fourth …

verses.pali: Catutthampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā …pe… parihāyi.
Pañcamampi kho āyasmā godhiko …pe… cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: fifth …

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmayikaṁ cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: sixth time Godhika experienced temporary freedom of heart.

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhampi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi.
verses.english: But for a sixth time he fell away from it.

verses.pali: Sattamampi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmayikaṁ cetovimuttiṁ phusi.
verses.english: For a seventh time Godhika, meditating diligent, keen, and resolute, experienced temporary freedom of heart.
Then he thought,
“I’ve fallen away from this temporary freedom of heart no less than six times.
Why don’t I commit suicide?”

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato godhikassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: And then Māra the Wicked, knowing Godhika’s train of thought, went up to the Buddha and addressed him in verse:
“O great hero, O greatly wise!
Shining with power and glory.
You’ve gone beyond all threats and perils,
I bow to your feet, O Clear-eyed One!
Great hero, master of death,
your disciple longs for death,
he’s planning for it.
Stop him, O light-bringer!
For Blessed One, renowned among men,
your disciple who loves your teaching,
a trainee who hasn’t achieved their heart’s desire—
how can they kill themselves?”

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā godhikena satthaṁ āharitaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Now at that time Venerable Godhika had already committed suicide.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā “māro ayaṁ pāpimā” iti viditvā māraṁ pāpimantaṁ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: Then the Buddha, knowing that this was Māra the Wicked, addressed him in verse:
“This is how the attentive act,
for they don’t long for life.
Having plucked out craving, root and all,
Godhika is quenched.”
Then the Buddha said to the mendicants,

verses.pali: “āyāma, bhikkhave, yena isigilipassaṁ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkamissāma yattha godhikena kulaputtena satthaṁ āharitan”ti.
verses.english: “Come, mendicants, let’s go to the Black Rock on the slopes of Isigili where Godhika, who came from a good family, committed suicide.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṁ yena isigilipassaṁ kāḷasilā tenupasaṅkami.
verses.english: Then the Buddha together with several mendicants went to the Black Rock on the slopes of Isigili.

verses.pali: Addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṁ godhikaṁ dūratova mañcake vivattakkhandhaṁ semānaṁ.
verses.english: The Buddha saw Godhika off in the distance on his cot, lying with aggregates cast off.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena dhūmāyitattaṁ timirāyitattaṁ gacchateva purimaṁ disaṁ, gacchati pacchimaṁ disaṁ, gacchati uttaraṁ disaṁ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṁ disaṁ, gacchati uddhaṁ, gacchati adho, gacchati anudisaṁ.
verses.english: Now at that time a cloud of black smoke was moving east, west, north, south, above, below, and in-between.
Then the Buddha said to the mendicants,

verses.pali: “passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etaṁ dhūmāyitattaṁ timirāyitattaṁ gacchateva purimaṁ disaṁ, gacchati pacchimaṁ disaṁ, gacchati uttaraṁ disaṁ, gacchati dakkhiṇaṁ disaṁ, gacchati uddhaṁ, gacchati adho, gacchati anudisan”ti?
verses.english: “Mendicants, do you see that cloud of black smoke moving east, west, north, south, above, below, and in-between?”
“Yes, sir.”

verses.pali: “Eso kho, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā godhikassa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṁ samanvesati:
verses.english: “That’s Māra the Wicked searching for Godhika’s consciousness, wondering:
‘Where is Godhika’s consciousness established?’

verses.pali: Appatiṭṭhitena ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇena godhiko kulaputto parinibbuto”ti.
verses.english: But since his consciousness is not established, Godhika is quenched.”

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṁ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
verses.english: Then Māra, carrying his arched harp made from the pale timber of wood-apple, went up to the Buddha and addressed him in verse:
“Above, below, all round,
in the four quarters and in-between,
I’ve been searching without success:
where has that Godhika got to?”
“He was an attentive and steadfast sage,
a meditator who loved absorption.
By day and by night he applied himself,
without concern for his life.
He defeated the army of death,
and won’t return for any future life.
Having plucked out craving, root and all
Godhika is quenched.”
So stricken with sorrow
that his harp dropped from his armpit,
that spirit, downcast,
vanished right there.
